the-vedanta-sutras-with-the-commentary-b: George Thibaut translates the Vedanta-Sutras with Ramanuja's commentary — the great text of Hindu philosophy. Volume 48 of the Sacred Books of the East opens India's deepest thought. A monument of scholarship. Max Müller's great series made Eastern wisdom known to the West.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-aegidius-of-v: A 1913 entry on Aegidius of Viterbo — Giles, the Augustinian cardinal and humanist. Thomas Shahan praises his eloquence and reforming zeal. He preached at the Lateran Council. Popes trusted his counsel. A prince of the Renaissance Church. His oration opened the Fifth Lateran Council.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ambo: A 1913 entry on the ambo — the early church's pulpit. Caryl Coleman traces its ancient form. Twin stairs climbed its stone desk. The lessons rang from its height. The first pulpits of Christendom. Its steps survive in the old basilicas. Its form lives on in the pulpit.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-annius-of-vit: This 1913 reference piece on Annius of Viterbo — the Dominican antiquary. Henry Schroeder tells his strange tale. His forged histories fooled the learned. The Renaissance loved its fables. A scholar of doubtful fame. His Berosus fooled the humanists. His museum housed the Etruscan finds.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-aribo: This 1913 reference article on Aribo — the Archbishop of Mainz. F.M. Rudge notes his imperial part. He crowned the Salian kings. The primacy of Germany was his. A prelate of the eleventh century. His see was Germany's primacy. His cathedral crowns the Rhine city.
